# Gallery mobile catalogue preference

Settings can show the Mobile application catalogue in ordinary browsers and installed PWAs. The preference is saved locally; native Capacitor iOS and Android apps still show it automatically.

Browser panels explain that device features require the native app. Visibility never grants plugin capabilities: the existing same-origin, Source-owned iframe broker and host prerequisite filtering remain in place. Hiding the catalogue preserves open examples and their Data.

No core or server API change is required. Remote Edit remains disabled on the hosted gallery.

Validation: module visibility/persistence/lifecycle and origin regressions, Python catalogue/panel checks, gallery regression tests, and local browser checks for reload, retained edits and unavailable native capabilities. Physical-device behavior is not claimed by browser tests.
